newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - FOB corn and soy values mixed.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - FOB corn and soy values mixed.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean and corn offers were mixed, while wheat values were unchanged Friday in lackluster dealings, export sources said.
"These soft and hard wheat markets are just dead," one export source said. "I've been staring at the same prices since Monday.

There was scant export news on Friday. Taiwan Sugar will tender Tuesday for a 30,000-tonne combined cargo of U.S. corn and soybeans. Most wheat export business is flowing to other countries because the U.S. wheat prices are not competitive, exporters said.
U.S. export market basis values remained underpinned by harsh travel conditions on Midwest rivers. Arctic-like air has left some areas unavigable, grains dealers said.
